node.title: Re^5: PadWalker's closed_over - but for our variables?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You know I'm picky about terminology, calling my "private" and package vars "public" would have been better.

I'm not an expert on the theory and terminology, I'm an engineer and I care more about how things work ;-)

Solutions are available by parsing the optree like demonstrated in [doc://B::Xref] [doc://B::Concise] and [doc://B::Deparse]

Yes, I was thinking about these too, it's too bad none of them provide exactly what you want already. [doc://B::Xref] seems like a decent starting point, unless of course someone has done this already (I don't know yet).
